function stripHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'|'/g, "'")
    .replace(/ /g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}
